properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued September 21 at 1:36PM EDT until September 22 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Marquette MI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 30 expected.

* WHERE...Baraga, Iron, and Southern Houghton Counties.

* WHEN...From 2 AM EDT /1 AM CDT/ to 9 AM EDT /8 AM CDT/ Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
properties.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent water pipes from freezing; wrap or drain or allow them to
drip slowly. Those that have in-ground sprinkler systems should drain
them and cover above-ground pipes to protect them from freezing.

NWSheadline: FREEZE WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 2 AM EDT /1 AM CDT/ TO 9 AM EDT /8 AM CDT/ TUESDAY
